notes.title: Virtual Virtual Reality 1.10.0 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 1.10.0 of Virtual Virtual Reality is here with updated controller support! 

[list]
[*] Compatibility fixes for Quest 1 and 2 via Oculus Link
[*] Fixed bug where Oculus Rift and Quest controllers appeared in-game as Vive controllers.
[/list]
